title: Sāvaraṇa Śrī-Gaura-pāda-padme Prārthanā
author: Verses 1 to 7 by Śrīla Narottam Dās Ṭhākur

text: tomā vinā ke dayālu jagata mājhāre
translation: Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa Chaitanya Mahāprabhu, kindly give Your grace to me; in the whole creation, there’s none as merciful as You.

text: mo-sama patita prabhu nā pāibe āra
translation: You descended just to save the fallen souls; O Lord, a soul as fallen as me is nowhere to be found.

text: hā hā prabhu nityānanda premānanda sukhī
translation: O Lord, O Lord Nityānanda ever in the joy of Your love; kindly give Your gracious glance, I am very sad.
Kindly give Your grace, Śrī Advaita Goswāmī, the Lord of Śrīmatī Sītā Ṭhākurāṇī; by the power of Your grace we may gain the service of Śrī Śrī Nitāi-Chaitanya.
The embodiment of Śrī Gaura’s love, Paṇḍit Gadādhar; Śrīvās Paṇḍit, Haridās Ṭhākur, you are the ocean of grace personified.

text: hā hā svarūpa sanātana rūpa raghunātha
translation: O my Lords, Śrī Svarūp Dāmodar, Śrī Sanātan, Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunāth Dās, Śrī Raghunāth Bhaṭṭa and Śrī Gopāl Bhaṭṭa. O my Lord Śrī Lokanāth Goswāmī.
Please grant Your blessings O Lord Śrī Śrīnivās Āchārya, for the company of Śrī Rāmachandra Chakravartī, Narottam Dās does pray.

text: tava jana-kṛpā māge ei adhama dāsa
translation: Kindly give Your grace, Śrīla Prabhupād Saraswatī Ṭhākur, manifestation of Śrī Gaura. This fallen servant begs the mercy of your associates. *(Verse by Śrīla Bhakti Rakṣak Śrīdhar Dev-Goswāmī Mahārāj)*
